gen-vt323-fs-rowan: Pixel-sharp and a bit neon, VT323 packs its letters tight and drops every hairline, while Rowan's curves open wide beneath it. Thin strokes there run about half the weight of the thick.
gen-yuji-mai-fs-literata: Yuji Mai spaces each word out in a measured beat, its letters almost sealed shut, with only modest swelling in the rounds. Literata then follows with wide-mouthed curves and sturdy hairlines, so a longer passage feels bookish and unhurried.
gen-zen-dots-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab brings a dignified, classic serif voice, with a gaping c and rounded lowercase that stand noticeably taller than its partner. Zen Dots, roomy and techy, sits above it and loosens the whole page.
gen-zen-dots-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One has a tall middle band, short ascenders and descenders, and a generous entry into the e, giving a literary, dignified serif texture. Zen Dots is the one for friendly, spacious tech display; Fauna One is the one for text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-glegoo: Spacious and techy up top, then something more editorial: Zen Dots hands off to a classic serif whose big counters sit in a tall lowercase. Refinement is the pair's real strength.
gen-zen-dots-gf-hanuman: Zen Dots gives every letter generous room around it, and that openness holds at each weight, while Hanuman's high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals feel traditional. Refinement is what the two share.
gen-zen-dots-gf-kadwa: Lots of space surrounds each Zen Dots letter, and the openings stay generous at every weight, which gives it a friendly tech look. Kadwa's open-ended curves and larger-than-usual x-height make a text serif that sits comfortably beneath it.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, its big visible entrances into curved letters and tall lowercase bodies filling most of the line height. Zen Dots, lighter in height and friendlier, gives the page a techy opening line.
gen-zen-dots-gf-piazzolla: Authoritative and refined, Piazzolla sets a text serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose e opens like a pried clasp. Under Zen Dots, a longer passage would feel confident and unhurried.
gen-zen-dots-gf-pridi: Pridi reads classic and refined, its small letters standing almost capital-sized. Zen Dots handles the spacious, friendly tech display, while Pridi's generous gaps between curve ends and stems carry the serif text.
